name: Louisa Food Products, Inc
old_description: Our mission is to be recognized as the leading provider of high-quality, frozen, filled pasta. To achieve this mission, Louisa Foods stays true to the core values that launched our success from the start.
about:
Louisa Food Products, Inc. operates from St. Louis, Missouri. The company traces its roots back over 50 years when St. Louis restaurateur Ferdinando Baldetti began producing scratch-made ravioli and pasta for local restaurants. Today, the business remains family-owned, now spanning four generations of the Baldetti family.

The company specializes in frozen, filled pasta products including toasted ravioli, ravioli, and tortellini. Production follows a daily scratch-kitchen approach: doughs are mixed from carefully milled wheat, vegetables are hand-chopped and roasted, meats are braised and stocks reduced in-house, cheeses are freshly grated, and pasta is made with semolina flour and eggs. The facility at 1918 Switzer Avenue houses a culinary center for ongoing recipe development.

Louisa Foods serves both foodservice and retail channels. Its pasta reaches restaurants, institutional kitchens, and grocery stores across the region. The company emphasizes relationships with customers ranging from independent restaurants to larger food distributors.

The Baldetti family's founding belief that "freshness matters" continues to drive operations. The company states its mission is to be recognized as the leading provider of high-quality frozen filled pasta, built on honesty, integrity, and responsiveness to customer needs.
